output.summary: The user wanted to plan an infliximab infusion that would fall during a three-week trip and asked about shifting it, then raised travel precautions, insurance, documentation, vaccines, and care if a flare occurred abroad. The assistant suggested coordinating an earlier infusion with the IBD team and provided a travel-preparation list; the user said this turned their worry into actionable steps and planned to call the team the next day.
